note: Begin and start are interchangeable synonyms here; no nuance lost.
Reach implies deliberative process vs neutral make; role shifts Patient to Theme.
Require sounds more formal/official than need; ex1 also adds passive voice.
Huge is an extreme adjective, arguably stronger than compositional very big.
Nominalization (arrival) is more formal/written register than the verb arrives.
Mend is informal/domestic register vs technical repair; ex2 also flips voice.
Comitative vs coordinate subject differs in focus; Past tense dropped in rhs.
